title: Boolean settings are editable in the connection properties
author: zgabi
body_snippet: The enums are OK, but I noticed that the user can edit the boolean values.. I think the boolean editors should be similar "combobox"-es with fixed true/false... or yes/no values.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Hi @zgabi, great eye — you're absolutely right! 👍

## Fix (commit 5c12264)

We overrode `GetStandardValuesExclusive()` in `YesNoTypeConverter` to return `true`, which tells the PropertyGrid that only the dropdown values (`Yes`/`No`) are valid — no more free-text editing for boolean fields.

This is already in `main`, so the next nightly build will include it.

## How to verify

1. Open any connection's properties
2. Click on a boolean field (e.g., "Use Console Session", "Redirect Disk Drives", e...
